The main takeaway from our work is that
the elastic scattering of alpha particles is a very good tool to probe the nuclear potential in the interior of the nucleus.
the elastic scattering cross sections for alpha particles from /sup 40,Ca and /sup 44/Ca can be well described by a single set of parameters for both real and potential parts.
the optical potential for alpha particles is well described by a single potential with fixed geometry and smooth energy behavior.
